Name: Hitme's Ladies Of The Valley (Genderbent Villagers) - ALPHA
Author: Hitme11
Description:
Change most, if not all, vanilla male characters to female, containing portraits and sprites for each character. This is the compilation of my previous Vanillaish Genderbent mods since I want to make it easier to update and maintain.

[b][color=#ff0000]!!This is an early version, it's not completed yet!![/color][/b]

[b]Q: Why did you upload an incomplete mod?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] I realised that some of you are messing with my Vanillaish mods, so I uploaded them despite being incomplete. In this way, I can share them as source materials so that you guys can make use of or edit them. Have fun! :)

[b]Q: Will there be seasonal versions of the ladies?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Possibly, but some people out there are trying to do their seasonal versions of my mod (thank you for all your support!), I'll leave the seasonal edits to them. Anyway, if anyone wants to contribute the modified version to the mod, you can either upload your version or send me your art if you have no plan to make it into a mod yourself, I'll try to re-edit and put them into this mod with credits (and if you okay with it, of course!). In the meantime, my priority should be making more base portraits/sprites for you to mess with.

Don't worry if someone doing the same things as yours, as long you are happy with it.

[b]INSTRUCTION:[/b]
- Put Ladies Of The Valley into your Mods folder.
- If you are using with Seasonal Cuter Outfits or DSV, make sure to turn off characters changes in those mods.
﻿- Check this mod configs if you want to turn off individual genderbent version. (only in English for now)
